title: Separate customer order evidence amounts by currency and quantities by unit
description: A user distinguishes customer approved-order amounts by original currency and order quantities by exact unit in the customer-shipment report. Replace unsafe customer-only monetary aggregation with customer plus raw order currency groups: supported currency has signed original order TotalAmount subtotal, unknown/invalid currency remains explicitly unknown with null subtotal and count evidence (keep distinct invalid source codes if necessary, never infer currency). OrderCount counts approved headers in that customer/currency group and is not shipment count. Add Application DTO evidence fields and pure grouping rules: within each customer/currency group derive exact-unit quantity groups from its nondeleted details; known units get signed decimal totals, blank/unknown units get count evidence with null quantity. Do not normalize distinct units, convert units, duplicate money across flattened unit rows or combine incompatible units. Legacy TotalQuantity is nullable, known only if complete detail evidence has one supported nonblank exact unit; mixed/missing-unit or incomplete detail evidence is unknown rather than zero. Expose safe unit evidence labels/group records and completeness reason. UI explicitly shows currency/unit/source evidence, null markers, stable order and removes generic cross-currency/cross-unit monetary/quantity KPIs. No changes to prices, order totals, warehouse transactions or currency enums. Development only: reuse existing customer-shipment menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. Preserve the verified existing sales-order source and identify it as approved-order evidence, never actual shipment or receipt evidence. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Customer/currency groups preserve original signed order amount only for known currency, null amount for unknown currency and header counts; no cross-currency sum or duplicated amounts from quantity-unit groups.

Exact-unit detail groups preserve signed quantities independently; unknown units and incomplete detail evidence remain unknown, while legacy TotalQuantity is nullable and known only for one complete nonblank unit.

Report UI safely displays currency/unit/source/null context with no actual-shipment claim or cross-unit/currency grand total; mixed/unknown currencies/units, missing details, revoked scope regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
